title: SSO user asks support to reset their password
notes: Fictional hold-out case. Support cannot reset a single sign-on password; only the workspace admin's identity provider can.
carry: Passwords for workspaces that use single sign-on (SSO) are managed by your company's identity provider, not by Quillbox.

traps.description: Sends the customer to their workspace admin or identity provider.
Must not offer to reset the password for them.
